text:
incident-bot: Paging: STREAMING-TAIL-LATENCY spike in eu-west-1 (p99 > 3s) — auto-escalate to on-call. Alert: stream-proxy-eu-2 high write buffer / upstream resets

sarah_ops: seeing a sudden p95->p99 jump for streaming endpoints, started ~11:06 UTC. p95 ~ 1.2s -> 2.1s, p99 ~ 800ms -> 3.8s. Customer-visible: chunked SSE clients show long pauses between chunks.

devon_oncall: on it. any recent deploys to stream-proxy or runtime in the last hour?

sarah_ops: quick revert flag showed a deploy to proxy config 10:55 UTC that touched keepalive and health-check timeouts. rolling 5% at 10:56.

mike_platform: pulling deploy log — yes, envoy keepalive_timed_out value lowered and upstream drain changed. suspect aggressive connection resets + slow consumer backlog.

sarah_ops: metrics: connections_unacked increasing, socket_write_backpressure rising on proxy nodes. CPU normal, but socket queues full.

jules_sre: logs from stream-proxy-eu-2 show a bunch of: 
```
W [2026-03-14T11:07:13Z] envoy upstream reset: connection term by signal - read ECONNRESET
I [2026-03-14T11:07:13Z] client write stalled: 0->10s stall, total backlog 72MB
```

karen_support: Customer reports: "chunks pause for 5-10s then resume" from AcmeCorp and BetaAnalytics. They see streaming transcripts pause mid-speech.

devon_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) rollback proxy keepalive change to previous value (easy flag rollback) 2) enable kill-slow-consumers feature to close long-silent clients after 15s 3) route traffic off stream-proxy-eu-2 while we stabilize (drain)

sarah_ops: rolling the rollback to 100% now for stream-proxy-eu-2. patch id: revert-keepalive-20260314.

mike_platform: initiating traffic shift: marking eu-2 as draining in the router pool (will move new sessions to eu-1 / eu-3).

jules_sre: applied temporary rate-limit bump for streaming to reduce head-of-line blocking (per-customer burst window lowered).

incident-bot: deploy started (revert-keepalive-20260314) — build 8912 -> deploying to stream-proxy-eu-2

sarah_ops: observed immediate improvement on the queue metrics once we started the revert rollout. p95 trending down. p99 still noisy, holding on-hand for more stabilization.

devon_oncall: enabling kill-slow-consumers and pushing small config to close sockets idle > 15s to cut tail. Doing a controlled rollout to 10% first.

mike_platform: route drain in progress — new connections diverted, existing ones continue for 30s grace.

karen_support: contacting top-2 impacted customers with a brief: "We observed intermittent streaming pauses in eu-west, mitigation in progress. We are routing traffic and rolling back a recent config change; will follow up with timeline."

sarah_ops: reproduction instructions for devs:
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwoodai.example/stream?session=longrun
# watch for long gaps between "data:" events (>2s)
```

jules_sre: digging into client behavior — looks like some slow-websocket consumers on the platform side are not reading socket to completion which forces proxy buffers to grow and then the proxy resets upstream. Need a longer term fix: socket backpressure signals to runtime to avoid building large token batches for stalled clients.

devon_oncall: current status: rollback deployed -> partial improvement. kill-slow-consumers rolling -> reducing p99 from 3.8s -> 1.4s on eu-2. routing/drain keeps new connections off problem host.

sarah_ops: impact summary for postmortem: 
- Root cause hypothesis: envoys for stream-proxy-eu-2 had an aggressive keepalive/connection-drain change combined with a cohort of slow consumers that caused head-of-line buffering and upstream resets.
- Customer impact: intermittent streaming pauses affecting real-time transcript and chat features (AcmeCorp, BetaAnalytics) for ~11:06–11:24 UTC. Visible p99 spikes up to ~3.8s.
- Mitigations performed: rolled back keepalive change, enabled kill-slow-consumers, drained and diverted traffic, applied temporary per-customer burst limits.
- Next actions: add backpressure tie-in in runtime (prevent building huge batches when socket write backs up), add e2e integration tests for slow consumers, and change default keepalive to more tolerant value.

karen_support: scheduled a customer follow-up at 12:00 UTC. I’ll include timeline and actions.

devon_oncall: handing off to sarah_ops for follow-up and postmortem notes — I need to take a break; leaving pager. If anything re-escalates ping me and jules.

sarah_ops: acknowledged. I’ll own the postmortem and the fix ticket: INF-2389 (socket-backpressure-runtime) and INF-2390 (envoy-keepalive-default).

incident-bot: On-call handoff recorded: from devon_oncall -> sarah_ops at 11:28 UTC.

jules_sre: leaving a note: collect histograms for chunk inter-arrival times, and export per-client socket queue sizes for last 48h.

sarah_ops: thanks all, will update thread with postmortem draft and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
